name: Tutor Payout Workflow
business_goal: Calculate tutor earnings and produce payout records and reports on a recurring schedule.
description: On the first day of each month at 02:00, the system retrieves completed sessions, calculates payout using session earnings minus fees/penalties/refunds plus bonuses, creates payout records, sends emails, generates admin reports/invoices and logs transactions.
trigger: Monthly cron job: 1st of month at 02:00.
